key_insight: PaPi replaces sequential time stepping in neuro-spectral architectures with time-parallel integration, reporting up to 100× faster training and inference.
engineering_relevance: Time-parallel integration can reduce the computational cost of learning and predicting time-dependent PDE dynamics in the frequency domain.
method: Combine exponential integration with Duhamel-Picard iteration.
Evaluate temporal dynamics in parallel rather than through sequential Runge-Kutta steps.
Establish exponential convergence with error bounds tied to the flow's closeness to linear.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experimental speedups of up to two orders of magnitude and sub-second training for low-dimensional PDE learning problems, with competitive predictive accuracy.
watch_item: Performance on high-dimensional or strongly nonlinear PDEs is not established by the abstract; error bounds depend on closeness to linear dynamics.
paper_title: PaPi: Parallel Picard-Duhamel Integration for Fast Neuro-Spectral Architectures
